name: Helix
tagline: Screens thousands of compounds against a cancer protein target and adds a quantum stability signal for the top ten.
problem: Drug screening is slow and lacks quantum-chemistry signals.
solution: Filters candidate compounds for a chosen cancer and target, ranks them, then runs a VQE quantum algorithm on the top ten for molecular stability.
demo_moment: Team-described: pick a target and see ranked candidates.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Most Philanthropic Hack - Bloomberg” among 223 submissions.
Adds a signal standard tools do not produce.

lessons: Use a new method only where it adds a distinct signal.
